declared_hypothesis: Nectar robbing imposes a more negative effect on female reproductive success than nectar theft; robbers pierce the corolla and are the antagonist a flower-specific barrier trait can exclude.
licensed_statement: Whether the realised fitness cost of floral larceny depends on whether the larcenist bypasses or uses the legitimate floral entrance.
interpretation: Primary context test and the theory-relevant contrast. If robbing is the costlier the barrier trait relieves the antagonist that matters and rho can be substantial; if theft is the costlier then e_F is small exactly where H is large their product collapses and the corollary predicts substitutability rather than conditional complementarity. Declared in the direction the source publication contradicts; see section 8 of the protocol.

declared_hypothesis: The effect of larceny on female reproductive success is less negative in self-compatible species because autonomous selfing buffers a pollination-mediated cost.
licensed_statement: Whether the realised fitness cost of floral larceny depends on the declared reproductive-assurance level.
interpretation: Direct test of the corollary's own auxiliary moderator R which enters the pollination-mediated term as (1 - c_R * R). A null constrains how much of the larceny cost can be pollination mediated at all.

declared_hypothesis: Observational larceny contrasts return a more negative effect than experimentally imposed ones because unmeasured flower quality covaries with larcenist choice.
licensed_statement: Whether the measured effect depends on how the larceny contrast was assigned rather than on larceny itself.
interpretation: Design audit. A significant contrast means the pooled estimate is partly a statement about study design and the experimental subgroup is the estimate that bears on H.

declared_hypothesis: The effect of larceny on female reproductive success differs among declared larcenist-pollinator functional-group combinations.
licensed_statement: Whether the realised fitness cost of floral larceny depends on the declared functional-group combination.
interpretation: Exploratory context test retained at 3 clusters per level. At that size the design detects only large contrasts and a null must be reported as uninformative rather than as evidence of no difference.

declared_hypothesis: Nectar robbing depresses legitimate visitation more than nectar theft.
licensed_statement: Whether any dependence of pollinator service P on antagonist pressure H is specific to the larcenist that bypasses the floral entrance.
interpretation: Applies the primary contrast to the assumption audit route. Any non-zero level here constrains the corollary's treatment of P and H as separable exogenous regimes and does not estimate a channel.

declared_hypothesis: Nectar robbing depletes nectar standing crop more than nectar theft.
licensed_statement: Whether the declared mechanism linking larceny to visitation depends on the larcenist type.
interpretation: Mechanism test. Its result is what makes a visitation effect interpretable as reward depletion rather than as direct interference or deterrence.
